family.description: In E. coli, SecM encodes a presecretory protein that regulates secA expression at the translational level. SecM contains a C-terminal sequence motif that induces a transient translation arrest [[cite:PUB00097606]]. SecM signal peptide plays an essential role in this regulatory process by acting as a molecular timer that coordinates secM membrane targeting with the synthesis of the arrest motif [[cite:PUB00097606]].
family.name: secA translation cis-regulator SecM, small type
